statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; conditional Tail risk is concentrated around the U.S. cash open and the 14:00 UTC Richmond-and-Fed cluster.
headline: NQ retraces overnight strength and rebounds from the session low ahead of a dense U.S. event cluster
body: Delayed December NQ is below its session open after reversing from the overnight high, but it has also rebounded from the session low. That two-way path weakens evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure. Oil, elevated long-term yields and the 14:00 UTC U.S. survey-and-Fed cluster keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours include Monday's technology-led one-way phase, with Tail peaking at 38% at 19:00 UTC, followed by sharp de-escalation after the cash session. The latest published 08:00 UTC assessment was 18% low Tail.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low-to-WATCH through Europe unless NQ develops persistent near-extreme holding or repeated failed retracements. Conditional risk concentrates around the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and the 14:00-14:20 UTC Richmond/Williams/Jefferson cluster, then should de-escalate if price discovery becomes two-way.

forecast.analysis: Observed structure is two-way: delayed December NQ is about 30,730.50, below its 30,813 open after reversing from 30,844.50, but above the 30,670 session low. The rebound from the low and earlier reversal argue against persistent no-retracement structure, while event risk keeps Stress extreme.
drivers: Delayed NQ reversed from 30,844.50 but rebounded from the 30,670 session low
VIX near 14.8 and the 10Y yield near 4.93% do not show a volatility shock
A dense U.S. survey-and-Fed cluster approaches at 14:00 UTC

forecast.analysis: If European trade remains rotational and NQ does not pin near an extreme, Tail stays near WATCH. A fresh directional push with shallow pullbacks would be the first meaningful escalation checkpoint.
As U.S. premarket participation builds, conditional Tail rises modestly. Repeated extension after failed retracements would matter more than the strong prior-session technology backdrop.
The Europe-to-U.S. handoff increases event sensitivity. Tail remains WATCH unless NQ is already stretched toward an extreme and mean-reversion attempts repeatedly fail before the cash open.

The 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open falls in this hour. Elevated Tail is conditional on opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks, repeated extensions, or near-extreme holding; a two-way open would weaken that case.

Richmond business surveys, Williams at 14:05 UTC and Jefferson at 14:20 UTC cluster here. Elevated Tail requires an observed one-way response or delayed second leg; the scheduled events themselves primarily raise Stress.

Post-cluster Tail remains elevated only if the first move keeps extending after failed retracements. Deeper pullbacks, two-way discovery or cross-asset stabilization would argue for rapid de-escalation.
drivers: Depth of retracements after the 14:00 cluster

forecast.analysis: If the event impulse has stabilized by this hour, Tail should fall back to WATCH. Persistent near-extreme holding with little retracement would keep the path riskier than the score implies.
Mid-session risk is lower unless earlier directional efficiency persists. A return toward the session midpoint or broader cross-asset disagreement would favor recoverable Stress over Tail.
Conditional Tail eases if price discovery remains two-way. A renewed impulse would matter only if it breaks the established retracement pattern and holds near a fresh extreme.

The U.S. power hour begins at 19:00 UTC. Tail returns to WATCH because late-session continuation can become efficient, but elevation requires persistent extension rather than ordinary closing volatility.
If the cash session reaches the 20:00 UTC close without persistent extension, Tail should return to low. Residual headline risk can keep Stress high even after directional equity pressure fades.
The scheduled CME maintenance interval limits observable NQ path evidence in this hour. Tail stays low unless an unresolved catalyst from the cash session creates credible reopen-gap risk.
drivers: No live NQ path during maintenance

forecast.analysis: At the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen, WATCH is conditional on a material gap with one-way follow-through. An orderly reopen with retracement would keep the overnight path below the block threshold.
Early Asia risk stays low if the reopen is orderly. Tail would rise only if liquidity thins while NQ repeatedly extends and fails to retrace.
If Asia remains balanced, Tail stays low and Stress gradually recedes. A geopolitical headline or abrupt yield move would first raise Stress unless NQ also develops persistent directional structure.

This overnight hour is expected to remain low Tail unless a new catalyst produces sustained directional efficiency. Ordinary range expansion without mean-reversion failure would not justify escalation.
drivers: Range expansion versus failed mean reversion

forecast.analysis: As Asian liquidity transitions toward Europe, Tail remains low. A clean handoff into a fresh trend would require near-extreme holding and shallow pullbacks to justify higher risk.
Late-Asia liquidity transitions toward Europe's pre-open phase. Tail remains low unless overnight direction survives that handoff with shallow pullbacks and sustained near-extreme holding.
European pre-open conditions may increase dispersion, but Tail remains low unless NQ and major cross-assets align into persistent one-way structure.
The final pre-open phase keeps Tail near WATCH only if overnight extremes are holding with weak retracements. Otherwise two-way overnight structure remains the base case.
Europe's pre-cash handoff can raise volatility, but WATCH still requires directional efficiency and weak retracements rather than ordinary opening preparation.
The European cash open falls in this hour. Tail is WATCH conditionally on an opening impulse that holds near an extreme and defeats retracement attempts.
European cash trade is established by this hour. Tail remains WATCH if opening direction persists with failed pullbacks; rotational trade would cap path risk.

forecastDetail.comment: Current delayed NQ shows a reversal from the high and a rebound from the low, supporting low Tail despite extreme Stress.
WATCH is conditional on European trade developing persistent direction with shallow pullbacks rather than ordinary rotation.
U.S. premarket liquidity raises sensitivity; failed retracements and repeated extension would be the key escalation evidence.
The Europe-to-U.S. handoff lifts conditional risk only if NQ holds near an extreme and mean reversion visibly weakens.
The 13:30 UTC cash open falls in this hour; elevated Tail requires observed opening continuation with weak retracement.
Richmond surveys plus Williams and Jefferson cluster here; elevated Tail requires an observed one-way response or delayed second leg.
